hyperedges.label: Schema Download to Generated API Pipeline

nodes.label: API Target
nodes.rationale: The public product currently points at the API target, so consumers import `API` until a hand-written SuwayomiKit target exists.

nodes.label: apollo-codegen-config.json
nodes.rationale: Changing schemaDownload.downloadMethod.introspection.endpointURL is the documented way to retarget the schema download at a different server.

nodes.label: Async/Await Client
nodes.rationale: Built on Apollo and Swift concurrency so callers get structured concurrency instead of callback-based GraphQL responses.

nodes.label: Generated GraphQL Layer
nodes.rationale: The GraphQL layer is generated rather than hand-written so that typed models stay in sync with the server schema; it currently exposes only the AboutServer query, with a hand-written convenience API planned to land incrementally.

nodes.label: Page and Thumbnail Fetching
nodes.rationale: Image retrieval cannot go through GraphQL, so it needs its own path supporting authentication and custom headers.

nodes.label: Schema Download (make schema)
nodes.rationale: Exposed as a make target so the local schema.graphqls can be refreshed from a live server before regenerating sources.

nodes.label: Server Discovery and Connection Handling
nodes.rationale: Handles base URL, credentials, and reachability so reader apps can point at any local or remote Suwayomi-Server instance.

nodes.label: Suwayomi-Server
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted manga server (formerly Tachidesk) that runs sources, manages a library, and serves chapters and page images; it is the backend SuwayomiKit talks to.

nodes.label: SuwayomiKit
nodes.rationale: A Swift package that provides a native Apple-platform layer over Suwayomi-Server so client apps avoid dealing with GraphQL directly.

nodes.label: Typed Models
nodes.rationale: Models cover manga, chapters, categories, extensions, and the library to replace untyped GraphQL dictionaries with compile-time checked types.

nodes.label: Project Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Tracks delivery order: package layout and public product, Apollo client and code generation, and the initial AboutServer query are done; core models, chapter/page retrieval, error model, tests, and DocC remain.

nodes.label: Do Not Format Generated Sources
nodes.rationale: Sources/API/Generated is overwritten on every code generation run, so formatting it would produce churn that is immediately discarded.

nodes.label: Swift 6 Strict Concurrency
nodes.rationale: Sendable models plus actor-isolated client state are required so the networking layer is data-race free under Swift 6 concurrency checking.
